findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
 * @description Complex regular expressions with nested quantifiers could lead to exponential backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall()
  ) and
  pattern = call.getArg(0) and
  exists(StrConst s | s = pattern.asExpr() |
    // Look for nested quantifiers or alternations that could cause exponential backtracking
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*[*+{][^]]*[*+{].*") or
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\|.*){3,}.*") or
    s.getText().regexpMatch(".*\\(.*[*+].*\\).*[*+].*")
  )
select call, "Regular expression with potentially exponential backtracking: " + pattern.asExpr().(StrConst).getText()
findings.hypothesis: Regular expressions with nested quantifiers could cause ReDoS attacks

message.text: Regular expression with potentially exponential backtracking: &(#\d+|#x\[0-9a-fA-F\]+|\w+);
Regular expression with potentially exponential backtracking: (\[<>\]|&(?!#\d+;|#x\[0-9a-fA-F\]+;|\w+;))
Regular expression with potentially exponential backtracking: ((^|;)\s*charset=)(\[^;\]*)
